anchorUnits: pixels from frame top-left; y down
style: HD painted pixel-art-flavoured, smooth antialiased RGBA, upper-left sun

assembly.anchor: All sprites use the waterline anchor [192,240]. Divide all sizes and offsets by four at concept display scale.
assembly.cliffs: Stamp fronts left to right along front-facing outline. 48px overlap is a starting point; vary foot y by up to 12px. Top lip masks into procedural island top.
assembly.corners: Put left/right headlands at outline turns, overlap their open continuation side with a front.
assembly.surf: Draw bands at cliff foot after cliff/outcrop sprites, with rings centered on outcrop waterline. Frame index shared per surf group.
assembly.tileTrueMeaning: Fronts are repeatable overlap decals along x, NOT seamless rectangular texture tiles. Do not repeat vertically.
assembly.limits: Large outline slopes need local placement/rotation; do not rotate far enough to rotate the vertical cliff facets away from screen vertical.
